dos.text: Use menuId pointing at a <panel-list> instead of writing custom open and close logic, the internal controller handles ARIA and open state for you.
Use real slotted content instead of label when you need more than plain text.

donts.text: Don't set type="split" without also setting menuId, the chevron renders but has nothing to open.

Don't expect a plain title HTML attribute to behave like a normal tooltip from outside, the component's own JSDoc notes it is used inside shadow DOM and mapped internally, not a typical reflected attribute.
